notes: Version 11.46. New: Settings now has a Sign out of the account button. Signing out frees this computer's seat at the site so another computer can sign in with the account, and the words on screen say plainly what happened - including when a seat move has to wait, and if the sign-out could not be finished. This build also carries the background-check fix from 11.40: a built-in system part can no longer be called bad - or cleared - by an old saved check. The phone build is 11.9.18.
